utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — if you can come by a little later, that would help a lot. We’re still sorting the last few repair items.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll stop by a little later and help sort the last few repair items.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m ready to help—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’m just checking the list first so we don’t miss anything. I’ll tell you the remaining fixes in a moment.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll wait for your list and jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies for the repair drive. What do you need me to note down?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo—just note whatever tools, screws, and spare wood people can bring. I might forget a few details, so I really appreciate you keeping track.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll note tools, screws, and spare wood as they come in. Just send me any updates, and I’ll keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m mostly worried about the logistics. We still need to confirm the supply list and who’s handling pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help confirm the supply list and sort pickup/drop-off if you want. Just send me whatever you have so far.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I can bring my tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’m still in. Thanks — I could really use the extra tools, so let’s do it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring them by Saturday morning. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a few more volunteers this afternoon. I can swing by and see what’s still needed if you want.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Tess — if you can check what tools or help they still need, I can bring over whatever I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll stop by this afternoon and see what tools and extra hands they still need. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got the word out about the repair drive—come by if you can, and feel free to bring anyone who’d like to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll come by and I’ll spread the word to a couple neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, Opal — thank you! I’ll keep sharing it around, and I’m really glad you’re coming.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just to confirm—you’re still good to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still good to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Bo — I’m keeping the repair drive list organized and we’re ready to match folks up when you are.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’m ready—just send me the next match when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ve got a match for you: Mr. Alvarez on Maple needs help with a leaky faucet this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep the list handy and stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Cleo — just send me the missing items when you know, and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just point me to what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Oren. There are a few things around the house that need a careful hand, and I’d appreciate it if you could take a look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course — I’m happy to help. Just show me the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll take a careful look.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’d love a hand spreading the word and lining up a few volunteers who can help with basic fixes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and ask around for a few handy neighbors who can pitch in. If you have a time and a simple sign-up list, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, send me the details and put me down if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and put your name down for help. Thanks, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help out with the repair drive. What kind of repairs still need doing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ve got a short list: a loose handrail, a squeaky gate, and one porch step that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the handrail and porch step, if that helps. When would you like me to come by?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—once I know the school pickup and drop-off times, I can plan around them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — pickup is at 3:15 and drop-off is at 8:10. I’ll send the full repair-drive schedule too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—send it over when you can, and I’ll work around those times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad to help connect folks for the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors and make sure they know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a huge help, Vik—thank you. I’ll line up the list of needed repairs and share it with you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand, and I’ve got a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s helpful, Gus. I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got the right tools and enough time to get everything there safely.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We should be fine if we pack the essentials first and leave a little buffer. I can bring my toolbox and help load things up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive location so I don’t miss it. Do you know where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’re meeting at the community center by the front entrance. I’ll make sure there’s a clear sign so you can find us بسهولة.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll head to the community center front entrance and look for the sign.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, what time is the repair drive starting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the details first—do you mean the repair drive at the community center? If so, I’ll confirm the start time and tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, the one at the community center. Thanks—please let me know the start time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help — what’s needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking the list now — we could use screws, duct tape, and a few work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I can bring screws and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive's getting started soon—what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—probably a few tools if you’ve got them, and maybe some gloves. I’m a little scatterbrained today, but I think that’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I'll bring some gloves and a couple tools if I can find them. Thanks, Noah!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm — this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — they’re moving ahead with it as planned.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — I just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate you keeping an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm glad I remembered to show up. What do you need me to help with, Leo?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools by type? Then we’ll box up anything missing parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Leo. I’ll sort the tools by type and set aside anything that looks incomplete.
